purpose: Test the one payoff still directly implied by the passed structural gate: after three causally observed same-wallet, same-coin, same-side child orders, can one fixed ML model identify schedules whose next child slice creates enough same-direction impact to survive realistic cost stress?

prior_evidence_and_boundary.parent_cadence_structure: The warmup-only structural probe found 76 continued runs among 126 three-child cadence runs, versus 635 continuations among 8415 activity-matched controls; continuation-rate ratio 7.993x.
prior_evidence_and_boundary.retired_wallet_skill: Prior-only wallet performance ranking failed its preregistered cohort-spread and concentration gates and is not an input to this experiment.
prior_evidence_and_boundary.retired_external_liquidity_payoff: The same parent cadence failed to predict delivery to the previous completed 15-minute external-liquidity pool; that target/stop geometry is retired and is not tuned here.
prior_evidence_and_boundary.opened_development_notice: Dates 2025-08-02 through 2025-08-04 were read under the distinct external-liquidity payoff. They are development confirmation here, not sealed final OOS. Only 2025-08-05 and 2025-08-06 remain untouched for this exact next-slice payoff.

trader_explanation: Three same-wallet, same-coin, same-side taker child orders with 20 to 40 seconds between starts reveal an active execution schedule after the third child has fully completed.
The parent side fixes direction. ML may accept or reject the schedule but may never reverse it.
Enter only after a two-second information delay and before the next cadence deadline or fourth child starts.
If a fourth same-side child starts on schedule, the position exits after that child fully completes and a further two-second observation delay.
If no fourth child starts within the frozen 40-second cadence window, the parent-order state is invalid and the position exits after the invalidation becomes observable.
A protective stop remains beyond the first-three-child origin extreme. The cadence deadline is signal invalidation, not an arbitrary elapsed-time liquidation.

event_contract.eligible_market_path: Every valid BTC, ETH, SOL or XRP fill, deduplicated by trade id; median duplicate price and earliest timestamp.
event_contract.eligible_flow_context: Every valid crossed target-coin fill with recognized side.
event_contract.eligible_parent_child: Crossed non-liquidation fill with recognized side, valid wallet, order id, timestamp, price and size.
event_contract.child_completion: Minimum and maximum fill timestamps, size-weighted VWAP, summed quote notional and majority non-empty cloid.
event_contract.sequence: The first causal three-order window in each same-side cadence run; both start-to-start gaps must lie in 20 to 40 seconds inclusive.
event_contract.detection: Maximum fill time of the third child, so full third-child VWAP and notional are known.
event_contract.entry: First same-coin market trade at or after detection plus 2000ms, rejected if more than 5000ms late, at or after the 40-second cadence expiry, or at or after a known fourth child's start.

exit_contract.protective_stop: For long, the minimum first-three-child VWAP buffered 2bp lower; for short, the maximum buffered 2bp higher.
exit_contract.fourth_child_state_exit: First market trade after the fourth scheduled child has fully completed plus 2000ms.
exit_contract.cadence_failure_state_exit: First market trade after third-child start plus 40000ms plus 2000ms when no scheduled fourth child exists.
exit_contract.stop_precedence: A structural stop observed no later than the causal state-exit trigger wins.
exit_contract.source_boundary: Unresolved accepted positions receive the full structural stop.
exit_contract.why_not_time_liquidation: The 40-second boundary is the preregistered condition under which the hypothesized parent schedule ceases to exist.

model_contract.training_target: Actual same-direction gross basis-point return to the causal parent-state exit, clipped only for model fitting to [-200, 200]bp; economic replay uses the unclipped observed return.
model_contract.direction_lock: The detected parent side is immutable; the regressor can authorize or reject only.

economic_decision.derivation: 18bp decision cost plus 2bp minimum predicted edge.

account_contract.simultaneous_priority: higher predicted gross return, then same-cloid indicator, then BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, then event key
account_contract.top_winner_counterfactual: Remove the largest positive 10 percent of 12bp event keys before slot arbitration and replay from initial NAV.
account_contract.sample_growth_calendar: Every fixed confirmation or validation date is included, including no-trade dates.
account_contract.funding: Not separately applied because the parent-state exit is intraminute and every source-boundary position is charged the full stop. Exact Bybit funding is mandatory after any survivor.

promotion_boundary: A validation pass opens only a separately frozen synchronized Bybit BBO/depth/funding reconstruction of the identical Hyperliquid events. This same-venue fatal screen cannot rank, open official 2024-2026 evaluation, optimize risk/leverage or submit orders.
